videos.title: Big Tech is ready to spend even bigger to win in 2028 | The Vergecast
videos.description:
The crypto and AI industries both spent huge on the 2026 US midterm elections. They’ll tell you otherwise, but they both lost big. Molly White, who writes Citation Needed and maintains the Tech Influence Watch spending tracker, joins the show to explain why AI and crypto couldn’t buy a win — and why they’re ready to spend even bigger in two years.

videos.title: Jensen Huang is Donald Trump’s Special Boy | The Vergecast
videos.description:
A few days after declaring it would not bring Jensen Huang back as CEO, Nvidia’s board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO. All it took, apparently, was a little bit of pressure from the White House. The Verge’s Hayden Field explains how President Trump intervened in the matter, what happens now that Huang is essentially invincible, and why this makes the whole AI industry even more fragile.
